title: The Variant Call Format Specification
sections: 5.2 Decoding VCF entries for SNPs and small indels
selected_excerpt: The value in the POS field refers to the position of the first base in the String.
interpretation: Simple indels use a padding base when a REF or ALT would otherwise be empty; the POS describes the first REF base. Position 1 and complex alleles have distinct rules. This does not establish a universal one-base shift for array probes.
payload_scope: Bibliographic metadata, one short quotation and a section paraphrase only.
